title: NER-SAFE Standardized Ground-Truth Landslide Inventory
data_leakage_safeguard: Strict operational separation: Historical landslide locations and occurrences serve exclusively as training/evaluation ground-truth target labels. They are NOT used as continuous predictors for themselves, ensuring zero data leakage in empirical landslide-risk modeling.

derived_rasters.landslide_presence_30m: Binary 0/1 indicator raster on the 30m master grid
derived_rasters.landslide_distance_meters_30m: Euclidean metric distance in meters to nearest historical event point
